# Check Cherry

Check Cherry is a business management platform for photography and event service companies, with tools for leads, bookings, appointments, offerings, payments, and workflows.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/check-cherry/.

## Actions

- **Attach Questionnaire**: Copy a questionnaire template onto a proposal or confirmed booking.
- **Check Event Availability** (read-only): Check whether a package can be booked on one date or across a date range.
- **Create Appointment**: Create a staff appointment for a guest at a specific date, time, and duration.
- **Create Expense**: Record a business expense with its payment date, amount, reference, payee, and optional event and category links.
- **Delete Appointment**: Soft-delete one appointment so it no longer appears in active business calendar records.
- **Delete Expense**: Soft-delete one business expense so it no longer appears in listings.
- **Get Appointment** (read-only): Return full guest, scheduling, and assignment details for one appointment.
- **Get Event** (read-only): Return full details for one proposal or confirmed booking by event ID.
- **Get Lead** (read-only): Return full details for one lead by ID.
- **Get Questionnaire** (read-only): Return one questionnaire with its questions, current answers, and completion state.
- **Get Report** (read-only): Return one time-bucketed Check Cherry business report for bookings, leads, payments, proposals, or projected revenue.
- **List Appointment Slots** (read-only): Return available appointment times for one staff member and appointment calendar on a selected date.
- **List Appointments** (read-only): Search staff appointments by date, assignee, brand, cancellation state, time direction, or text, returning one page.
- **List Event Bookings** (read-only): List package bookings attached to events within an optional event-date range, returning one page and a continuation cursor.
- **List Events** (read-only): Search proposals and confirmed bookings with date, status, client, staff, payment, and workflow filters, returning one page.
- **List Expense Categories** (read-only): Return the expense categories available for classifying business expenses.
- **List Expenses** (read-only): Search business expenses by event, category, payment date, text, and sort order, returning one page.
- **List Leads** (read-only): Search leads by exact email or contact and event text, returning one page of CRM records.
- **List Offerings** (read-only): List one Check Cherry catalog resource.
- **List Payments** (read-only): List event payment records, including received payments and refunds, by event or payment date.
- **List Questionnaire Templates** (read-only): Return questionnaire templates that can be attached to an event booking.
- **List Questionnaires** (read-only): List questionnaires attached to one event booking.
- **Remove Questionnaire**: Detach one questionnaire from its event booking and delete its collected answers.
- **Update Expense**: Change selected fields on an existing business expense.
- **Update Questionnaire Answers**: Update answers on a standard questionnaire.
